run_pack_metadata: run the script to pack metadata JSON files from an input directory into an output directory
run_portable_paths: run the script to replace absolute scene paths with portable dataset-relative keys in metadata files
run_statistics: run the script to compile and print image count statistics per scene dataset level
review_metadata_packing: review the script that packs habitat sim dataset metadata files for portability across environments
summarize_metadata_tool: summarize the utility script that processes metadata.json files and normalizes scene paths for dataset regeneration
